snippet.title: Top-down PVE Co-op Extraction Shooter No Such Place hits Steam Early Access Now!
snippet.description:
Attention, U.R.C. Agents: Thank you for your patience. 
The Advance Phase Dimensional Fragments Exploration Operation is officially underway. 
The U.R.C. has decoded a set of new dimensional coordinates. Please check your terminal inbox immediately to deploy for the next phase of the mission.
Scans across these coordinates have detected newly documented firearms, research data, and high-value loot—assets that will prove vital in supporting your upcoming tours of duty. 

Notice on Legacy Agent Data: If you previously took part in our initial dimensional reconnaissance operations, your Agent profile and accrued loot can still be deployed in this Advance Phase. However, all mission progress will reset. 
Data carried over from early legacy builds may cause unforeseen system anomalies and glitches; we strongly advise deploying with a fresh agent for this run.
We extend our sincere gratitude for the extensive feedback and steadfast support you provided throughout our preliminary survey phase.

We will see you out across the ever-changing dimensional fragments.  
    — U.R.C. Research & Development Division   
 #extractionshooter  #shootergames  #steam  #indiegame   #pixelart   #gunsmith #unityengine  #chillyroom  #coopgaming
